dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans in Sermata Islands
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by form lines and spot heights, depths by soundings.
Primarily in Japanese, with titles and map text also in English.
Soundings and heights are in meters.
Publish date "昭和" taken from bottom margin.
Shows depths, reefs, low water areas, buildings, marshland.

Chart 1. Romang (Roma) and Approaches -- Chart 2. Damar (Dammer) and Approaches -- Chart 3. Rumahkuda B. -- Chart 4. Anchorage on the North Coast of Nila -- Chart 5. Meatei Miarang Ancho. -- Chart 6. Telok Solat (Kulewatti B.) -- Chart 7. Babar and Approaches [Inset 1. Tepa Road -- Inset 2. Channel between Dawera and Daweloor] -- Chart 8. Lèti to Sermata -- Chart 9. Lèlang Road -- Chart 10. Serwaru Anchorage.
